summary: 31-year-old female from Westminster injured her ankle on the Devil's Thumb Trail; Nederland Fire Protection District, Boulder County Open Space rangers and Rocky Mountain Rescue Group responded ~2 mi up the trail; she hiked down with NFPD assistance, got a UTV ride from RMRG to the shuttle bus stop, then declined further medical treatment and left with friends (BCSO case 22-03122)
responding_agency: Rocky Mountain Rescue Group, Nederland Fire Protection District, Boulder County Open Space, Boulder County Sheriff's Office
notes: DATE NOTE: the BCSO release text dates the call 'Saturday July 3, 2022' — but 2022-07-03 was a Sunday (Saturday was July 2). Row keeps the explicit July 3 date; one-day ambiguity possible.
